role: typed interoperability boundary for external team-mux agent and memory records

ownership.agent_spec: TypeScript decodes configurations/agent-spec.json, extracts README metadata when the spec is absent, validates safe agent ids, and atomically writes exported README/spec files
ownership.memory: TypeScript resolves the configured team-mux root, rejects symlinked roots/agent paths/memory directories, validates memory JSON objects, and renders summaries
ownership.shell: lib/teammux-bridge.sh invokes the compiled node bundle and owns no JSON, text, path, or orchestration contract

invariants: agent ids are single safe path components
JSON output is serialized by JSON.stringify rather than shell interpolation
exported files are written through private temporary files and atomic rename
memory reads are restricted to working, semantic, episodic, or all
malformed memory records render an explicit read error and are never parsed by shell tools
missing typed bundle or configured roots fails closed; no shell fallback is attempted
deletion_gate: remove lib/teammux-bridge.sh once all callers invoke lib/runner-teammux-bridge.js directly and the external CLI packaging no longer requires a shell entrypoint
